messages:
Elaine: Quick sync: PR 524 edits the style guide, a migration note, and a handful of SDK examples. I ran into a few inconsistent terms and one broken link. Can we tidy before merge?
Sam: Which terms are jumping around?
Elaine: Short list:
- \"hosted API\" vs \"Redwood API\" used in different pages
- \"Dedicated\" vs \"Dedicated capacity\"
- SDK examples show both `client.generate()` and `client.chat.create()` variants
- Glossary entry for rollout is mixing canary/A-B language

Jess: For voice, prefer concise imperative guidance. Also: small caps for generic nouns (hosted API -> hosted API), but brand names stay Title Case (Redwood API).
Michael: Could we add a canonical-terms bulleted block at the top of the style guide so new edits reference one place? Keeps things consistent across repo.
Elaine: I'll add that. Proposal (short bullets):
- Redwood API 12 our hosted inference endpoint
- Dedicated capacity 12 reserved GPU pools for customers
- Private deployment 12 VPC/on-prem deployments

Elaine: Also updating the glossary: switching to \"staged rollout\" and a focused definition. Draft below:
```
staged rollout (n.) 12 deploying a model version to production in controlled stages. Start with a canary (small traffic share) to validate quality and metrics, then ramp. Use \"A/B\" only when you explicitly split cohorts and compare metrics.
```

Sam: Good. For SDK examples, the most current shorthand is: 
```
resp = client.chat.create(model=\"redwood-1\", messages=[...])
```
Replace other variants with that or a short wrapper example.

Elaine: Noted. I also found a broken internal link in the migration guide: `/docs/migrate/v1-to-v2#batching` -> 404. docs-bot showed it in CI.
docs-bot: [link-check] PR 524: 1 broken link found 12 https://ci.redwood/docs-linkcheck/524

Jess: Minor: prefer the term \"staged rollout\" in examples too, e.g., \"Canary (5%) -> monitor latency & hallucination rate -> ramp to 100%\". Keep present-tense verbs.
Michael: Add a one-line example to the glossary to make the intent explicit.

Elaine: I'll push a patch: add canonical bullets to top of style guide, replace SDK snippets across `docs/sdk/*`, fix the migration link, and update glossary. ETA ~20m. Anyone available to do a quick voice pass after?
Sam: I can scan for voice and leftover old API usage after you push (10-15m). I'll also re-run link-check locally.
Elaine: Pushed. PR comment: \"canonical terms block + staged rollout glossary + SDK snippet updates; fixed migration link\". CI started.
docs-bot: CI: link-check started for PR 524 12 https://ci.redwood/docs-linkcheck/524
Sam: Found one remaining example in `guides/prompting.md` using `client.generate()`; pushed a tiny fix to your branch.
Elaine: Thanks, pushed commit to branch.
docs-bot: [link-check] PR 524: 0 broken links. :white_check_mark:
Sam: Voice pass done. Left two tiny nits (wording + one passive sentence) as inline comments.
Elaine: Addressed both and squashed. Ready to merge once CI green. Any objections to merging after the green run? :+1:
Jess: :+1:
Michael: :+1:
Sam: :+1: will keep an eye on post-merge redirects
Elaine: Merged. Thanks all!
